changeSet.author: homologation
changeSet.sql: UPDATE reference_operation SET vue = CASE WHEN code = '6' THEN 'AFFECTATION' WHEN code = '12' THEN 'COORDONNEES' WHEN code IN ('15', '16', '17') THEN 'ESSAIS' WHEN code IN ('18', '19', '20', '23', '24', '25', '26') THEN 'DECISION' WHEN code IN ('21', '22') THEN 'ATTESTATIONS' WHEN code IN ('32', '33', '34', '35') THEN 'MISE_EN_SERVICE' WHEN code = 'C1' THEN 'CEREMONIE' WHEN geste = 'AFFECTER_RESSOURCES' THEN 'AFFECTATION' WHEN geste = 'COORDONNEES_TECHNIQUES' THEN 'COORDONNEES' WHEN geste = 'CONSTATER_COUVERTURE' OR particularite IN ('ENTREE_ESSAIS', 'FIN_ESSAIS') THEN 'ESSAIS' WHEN geste = 'FICHE_SUIVI' OR particularite = 'SERVICE_SUPPLEMENTAIRE' THEN 'MISE_EN_SERVICE' WHEN particularite = 'CEREMONIE_CLES' THEN 'CEREMONIE' WHEN declencheur = 'certification.attestations-archived.v1' THEN 'ATTESTATIONS' WHEN declencheur IS NOT NULL THEN 'DECISION' ELSE 'AUCUNE' END WHERE vue IS NULL;

UPDATE parcours_operation po SET vue = ro.vue, etape_code = COALESCE(ro.etape, po.etape), consultes_recoivent_tache = ro.consultes_recoivent_tache FROM reference_operation ro WHERE ro.version_id = po.version_id AND ro.code = po.rang;
UPDATE parcours_operation SET etape_code = etape WHERE etape_code IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE reference_operation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_reference_operation_vue CHECK (vue IS NULL OR vue IN ('AUCUNE', 'AFFECTATION', 'COORDONNEES', 'ESSAIS', 'DECISION', 'ATTESTATIONS', 'MISE_EN_SERVICE', 'CEREMONIE'));

changeSet.author: homologation
changeSet.sql: UPDATE parcours_operation SET depots = jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object( 'livrable', livrables -> 0 ->> 'code', 'documentRef', preuve ->> 'documentRef', 'nom', preuve ->> 'nom', 'empreinte', preuve ->> 'empreinte', 'deposeLe', preuve ->> 'deposeLe', 'deposePar', preuve ->> 'deposePar', 'repris', true)) WHERE depots IS NULL AND preuve IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(preuve ->> 'documentRef', '') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$' AND jsonb_typeof(livrables) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(livrables) > 0;

changeSet.author: homologation
changeSet.sql: UPDATE parcours_liaison pl SET institutions_liees = jsonb_build_object('BANQUE_PARTENAIRE', jsonb_build_object('id', l.banque_partenaire_id::text)) FROM liaison l WHERE l.id = pl.liaison_id AND l.banque_partenaire_id IS NOT NULL;

UPDATE parcours_operation SET raci = regexp_replace(raci::text, '"id": "EXT-[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*", "nom": "[^"]*", "fonction": "([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)"', '"id": "A_AFFECTER:\1", "nom": "Non affecté (\1)", "fonction": "\1"', 'g')::jsonb WHERE raci::text ~ '"id": "EXT-[A-Z]';

UPDATE parcours_operation po SET raci = replace(po.raci::text, '"id": "A_AFFECTER:BANQUE_PARTENAIRE", "nom": "Non affecté (BANQUE_PARTENAIRE)"', '"id": "EXT-' || l.banque_partenaire_id::text || '", "nom": "Banque partenaire"')::jsonb FROM liaison l WHERE l.id = po.liaison_id AND l.banque_partenaire_id IS NOT NULL AND po.raci::text LIKE '%A_AFFECTER:BANQUE_PARTENAIRE%';
